text: The model flags CUST004099 as high‑risk, meaning its chance of leaving in the next ≈ 9 months is well above the average customer. The three biggest drivers are very low support satisfaction (1 out of 5 versus a 3.3 average), a high share of failed payments (25 % versus 7 % average), and a poor overall feedback rating (1 out of 5 versus 3.2 average). Protective factors include that the customer has an active scored support ticket, an auto‑renew setting turned on, and relatively low recent watch minutes (38 versus 135 average). Note: the model’s predictions are modest and should be used as guidance, not certainty.
